scope: Complete the actual reference workflow with keyboard/table equivalents at 360px and 1440px, invalid/empty/interrupted/provider-outage cases and N-1 data/export fixtures. Advertise only observed supported platforms (Requirement N33).
source_identity_method: SHA-256 over sorted C33-owned implementation, test, fixture, and ux-evidence paths; each file contributes its path, a NUL separator and its own binary SHA-256. Excludes plans/, docs/agents/SESSION_HANDOFF.json, status-only README/START_HERE/DEFINITION_OF_DONE and docs/evidence/ to avoid recursive self-reference. Historical evidence remains bound to its original source.

environment.npm: 11.17.0 (toolchain lock pins npm 11.9.0; the executing npm reports 11.17.0)

hardware.required_profile: 4 vCPU / 8192 MiB RAM / 20480 MiB free disk

fixtures.provenance: Repository-authored synthetic reference UX workflow fixtures, failure states, legacy N-1 metadata schemas and expected output contracts; contains no real credential, provider state or plaintext secret.

commands.summary: Validated 40 detailed tasks, resources, references and progress; no runtime capability inferred.

39 Playwright tests passed across 7 parallel workers, including 360px mobile viewports, 1440px desktop layouts, skip links, keyboard tab navigation, modal Escape handling, empty input validation, malformed file alerts, 503 provider outages, N-1 backwards compatibility, and advertised platform checks.
35 web and contract tests passed, verifying web foundation, runtime health, preview bounds, security headers, and release fixtures.
All Go engine packages passed; lifecycle, internal auth, vaults, storage, and domain integration tests passed.
Validated 327 JSON files, OpenAPI schemas, and repository invariants.

results.acceptance: Complete the actual reference workflow with keyboard/table equivalents at 360px and 1440px, invalid/empty/interrupted/provider-outage cases and N-1 data/export fixtures. Advertise only observed supported platforms.

invariants_verified.viewports: Enforced; zero horizontal scroll overflow at 360px mobile viewport across all routes; clean desktop grid/panel layout at 1440px.
invariants_verified.keyboard_navigation: Enforced; skip link focuses #content; sequential tab order across interactive controls; Escape dismisses modal dialogues and clears transient secret plaintext.
invariants_verified.failure_handling: Enforced; empty input displays inline validation error and suppresses network dispatch; malformed file inspection displays explicit alert; 503 provider outage fails closed with zero plaintext exposure.
invariants_verified.backward_compatibility: Enforced; N-1 legacy secret metadata omitting newer lifecycle fields safely defaults to ACTIVE status without error.
invariants_verified.platform_scope: Enforced; packages and documentation advertise strictly observed platforms (linux-x86_64); unobserved architectures are omitted.
invariants_verified.provider_ownership: Enforced; OpenBao retains seal and ownership of secret bytes; Keycloak governs user identity and step-up auth; provider outage fails closed.
